messages.author: 877cd740823aa09d
messages.subject: oauth_listener() needs an interactive environment in working with Google Drive, shiny app fails to start on shinyapps.io server
parts:
I have a shiny app that used to run on shinyapps.io server (was uploaded in February).   App still runs locally.    However, on deployment to shinyapps.io server, the app now fails (see below) :  oauth_listener() needs an interactive environment

googlesheets author jennybc suggested a fix, getting a new .httr-oauth file in my working directory, https://github.com/jennybc/googlesheets/issues/235    This fix did not work.   I tried replacing the newest version of googlesheets package (0.2.0) on CRAN with an earlier version 0.1.0.9001, in case the updated googlesheets package had indeed caused the problem.   Same error with the earlier version.

It looks like my app on the shinyapps.io server is trying to communicate/authorize with Google Drive in interactive mode,.   Looking for suggestions to repair, as this is a production app for my team and now we're dead in the water.  Thank you!

messages.subject: Re: oauth_listener() needs an interactive environment in working with Google Drive, shiny app fails to start on shinyapps.io server
parts: A simple solution:   Tareef from RStudio identified the issue I ran into as inconsistent behavior of the PUBLISH functionality in the RStudio IDE.   If you use rsconnect::deployApp(), the "old" way will work--that is, if you have a valid .httr-oauth file in the working directory, the deployApp function loaded all the bits needed for my legacy shiny app to load to the shinyapps.io server.    So while MarkEdmondson1234's fix will indeed work (and is necessary if you want to continue using the PUBLISH button in RStudio 0.99.892 or 0.99.893), for those of us with legacy shiny apps, avoid PUBLISH until the bug is fixed.
